# Proverbs 18 — Disagreement Log
**Generated by:** SOPHIA | **Threshold:** <70% word overlap

---

## 18:1 (overlap: 0%)

| Translator | Rendering |
|---|---|
| EMET | For-desire one-separating-himself seeks; against-all sound-wisdom he-breaks-out. |
| LOGOS | Whoever isolates himself seeks his own desire; he breaks out against all sound judgment. |
| PNEUMA | People who isolate themselves are only chasing their own agenda — they're fighting against every bit of good advice. |

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.

## 18:2 (overlap: 0%)

| Translator | Rendering |
|---|---|
| EMET | Not does-a-fool delight in-understanding, but-only in-revealing his-heart. |
| LOGOS | A fool takes no pleasure in understanding, but only in expressing his opinion. |
| PNEUMA | A fool doesn't care about understanding anything — they just want to hear themselves talk. |

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.

## 18:5 (overlap: 0%)

| Translator | Rendering |
|---|---|
| EMET | To-lift [the]-face-of [the]-wicked [is]-not good, to-turn-aside [the]-righteous in-judgment. |
| LOGOS | It is not good to be partial to the wicked or to deprive the righteous of justice. |
| PNEUMA | It's wrong to let the guilty off the hook or to deny justice to someone who's done right. |

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.

| LOGOS | A fool's lips walk into a fight, and his mouth invites a beating. |
| PNEUMA | A fool's words pick fights, and their mouth begs for a beating. |

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.
